# Sing-Along

> A free, open-source desktop music player with synced lyrics for music you
> already own. It plays local files, downloads matching lyrics from LRCLIB,
> edits timing line-by-line or word-by-word, converts Simplified/Traditional
> Chinese, and exports to LRC, enhanced LRC (A2) and TTML.

Sing-Along is built with Tauri v2 (Rust backend, Vue 3 frontend) and runs on
Linux, Windows and macOS. MIT licensed. It began as a fork of LRCGET and no
longer tracks upstream.

## What an agent needs

A statically linked command-line build is published with every release and needs
no GTK, WebKit or ALSA installed:

| Platform | File |
| -------- | ---- |
| Linux x86_64 | `singalong-cli-linux-amd64` |
| Linux arm64 | `singalong-cli-linux-arm64` |
| macOS Apple Silicon | `singalong-cli-macos-arm64` |
| Windows x86_64 | `singalong-cli-windows-amd64.exe` |

Download from <https://github.com/LeisureLinux/Sing-Along/releases/latest>, then:

```
chmod +x singalong-cli-linux-amd64
./singalong-cli-linux-amd64 --version
```

Do not download the `.deb`, `.rpm`, `.AppImage`, `.dmg` or `.exe` to get a
command line: those are the desktop player and need a webview installed. Extracting
the binary out of one is a trap — it runs only where WebKitGTK happens to exist,
which is usually the machine it was tested on.

## Commands

```
singalong-cli status <path>                 what lyrics a folder is missing
singalong-cli fetch  <path>                 download the missing ones
singalong-cli export <path> --for <player>  write them in a player's format
singalong-cli formats                       list valid player names
```

The `--for` value is not interchangeable — word-level lyric formats differ per
player. Steve on iOS reads word timing only from TTML; Gramophone and Fluxio
(Android) only from enhanced LRC. Sending one to the other shows the timestamps
as lyric text.

## Two rules that matter most

1. **Never translate or rewrite lyric text.** It is someone else's work. The only
   permitted transformation is Chinese script conversion, and only when asked.
2. **A track with only unsynchronised text cannot be made synced.** LRCLIB may
   have the song but not a timed version; `fetch` reports this as
   `no timed lyrics`. Say so plainly rather than retrying.

## Lyrics sources

- [LRCLIB](https://lrclib.net) — primary, open and community-run
- NetEase — optional fallback, unofficial API, can break
